tool_args.rationale: The mobility-bridge signature maps to the inland-hub siphon. The acquired low/high sink-gradient contrast adds the missing variation needed to fit the two-layer sink inhibition and open square-root branch; fit the three parameters numerically. The previous confirmation error arose because predict passed a row without y back into fit; this implementation fits only on training rows and predicts directly from stored fitted parameters.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: No evidence indicates an avalanche regime; the existing gradient contrast at 2.3 is below the documented threshold for that targeted probe.
The rows are single-horizon and the bridge signature identifies the static inland-hub siphon mapping; trajectory measurements are unnecessarily costly.

considered_alternatives.option: inland-hub siphon with negative square-root branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fitted open-branch coefficient is estimated numerically from the gradient-contrast rows rather than imposing the opposite sign a priori.
Auxiliary noise does not resolve the identified response law and is expressly irrelevant.
